description: Find reviewed public payment product scopes using country, region, currency, flow, method and integration filters. Filters must match the same scope. Confirmed and currency_leads are separately paginated with the same page and limit; each has total_items, total_pages and items. A currency lead has unknown country coverage. Missing data is unknown.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; excluded countries do not match.

currency.description: Currency or crypto asset code. A ticker does not imply a network.

integrations.description: Any selected integration; all filter categories must match one product scope.

limit.description: Maximum records per group per page, from 1 to 20 (default 10).

methods.description: Any selected method; all filter categories must match one product scope.

page.description: Page of each result group, starting at 1. Keep filters and limit unchanged; a group past its total_pages is empty.

query.description: Case-insensitive provider name or summary substring.

name: search_payment_capabilities
title: Search payment capabilities
